mapper.sql: id, session_id, state_key, state_value, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_orchestration_state WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_orchestration_state (session_id, state_key, state_value, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{stateKey}, #{stateValue, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, 1, #{updatedBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: INSERT INTO ai_orchestration_state (session_id, state_key, state_value, version, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{stateKey}, #{stateValue, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, 1, #{updatedBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state_value = VALUES(state_value), version = version + 1, updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_orchestration_state WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND state_key = #{stateKey}
